# iNEST_Neuromorphic_Integration

**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
The in-network neuromorphic computing approach that embeds spiking neural network processing directly into the data interconnect fabric. Enables event-driven, energy-efficient computation at the network edge, reducing data movement and latency for sensor and AI workloads.
